title: Healthchecks
descript: Healthchecks is a watchdog for your cron jobs, backups and scheduled tasks: each check gets a unique URL, your script pings it when it runs, and Healthchecks alerts you when a ping is late or missing. It also offers status badges, a public status page and email/webhook/Slack notifications - perfect for spotting a backup that silently stopped.
release_note: 1. First release: Healthchecks 5.0.3 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Cron/backup watchdog with ping URLs, status pages and notifications; settings and SQLite database in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Create an account on first visit, then add a check and call its ping URL from your script (curl). Data and settings live in DockerAppData/healthchecksdocker/config. Notification emails build their links from SITE_ROOT, which is seeded as http://localhost:8000 - edit SITE_ROOT in config/local_settings.py to your NAS URL and restart the app. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

wrapper_note:
the LinuxServer.io image runs its init and uWSGI through s6 as root; s6 cannot
start in a non-root container, so this wrapper copies the app to /tmp, wires the
Django local settings and SQLite database to the data folder and starts uWSGI
directly as uid 1000.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: the upstream s6 init cannot run as uid 1000; the wrapper copies the app to a writable directory, wires `local_settings.py`/`hc.sqlite` to the data folder and starts uWSGI directly.

zh-cn.descript: Healthchecks 是定时任务与备份的看门狗：每个检查项都有一个专属 ping 地址，脚本跑完就请求一下，迟到自己没跑就会告警。它还提供状态徽章、公开状态页，以及邮件/webhook/Slack 通知——特别适合发现“备份悄悄停了”这类问题。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次访问先注册账号，然后新建检查项，把它的 ping 地址加到你的脚本里（curl 一下即可）。数据与设置保存在 DockerAppData/healthchecksdocker/config。通知邮件里的链接基于 SITE_ROOT，默认写的是 http://localhost:8000——请把 config/local_settings.py 里的 SITE_ROOT 改成你的 NAS 地址后重启应用。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Healthchecks 5.0.3，以非 root 容器运行。定时任务/备份看门狗，支持 ping 地址、状态页与通知；设置与 SQLite 数据库保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Healthchecks 是定時任務與備份的看門狗：每個檢查項都有一個專屬 ping 位址，腳本跑完就請求一下，遲到自己沒跑就會告警。它還提供狀態徽章、公開狀態頁，以及電郵/webhook/Slack 通知——特別適合發現「備份悄悄停了」這類問題。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次存取先註冊帳號，然後新增檢查項，把它的 ping 位址加到你的腳本裡（curl 一下即可）。資料與設定保存在 DockerAppData/healthchecksdocker/config。通知郵件裡的連結基於 SITE_ROOT，預設寫的是 http://localhost:8000——請把 config/local_settings.py 裡的 SITE_ROOT 改成你的 NAS 位址後重啟應用。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Healthchecks 5.0.3，以非 root 容器運行。定時任務/備份看門狗，支援 ping 位址、狀態頁與通知；設定與 SQLite 資料庫保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/config` (mounted from `DockerAppData/healthchecksdocker/config`) holds `hc.sqlite`, `local_settings.py` (SECRET_KEY, ALLOWED_HOSTS, SITE_ROOT) and the uploads folder.
design_notes: **s6 bypassed.** The LSIO init and its uWSGI service need root; the wrapper copies the app to `/tmp/hc` (writable) and runs uWSGI as uid 1000.
**Host header acceptance.** `ALLOWED_HOSTS = ["*"]` is seeded so the UI works from any NAS IP; the user-editable `SITE_ROOT` controls absolute links in notifications.
**SQLite only.** The database is a single file in the data folder.
limitations: - Notification links use SITE_ROOT (seeded as localhost) until you edit it in `local_settings.py`.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- The image is copied to /tmp on every start; the persistent state is only in the data folder.
